scheme_name: AB PM-JAY expansion for senior citizens (Ayushman Vay Vandana Yojana)
official_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana - Vay Vandana (70+ expansion)
responsible_ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
description: Universal (income-agnostic) expansion of AB PM-JAY covering all Indian citizens aged 70 and above, launched 29 October 2024, providing Rs 5 lakh/year cover (or an additional Rs 5 lakh top-up for families already on PM-JAY).
target_population: All Indian citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of income or socio-economic status.
